title: Data Scientist - WFO - Jakarta (ID: 708201)
job_description:
Position : Data Scientist
Location : Jakarta
Role Summary & Responsibility :
Discuss with clients to confirm KPI definitions, event taxonomy, segmentation logic, and data quality expectations; document definitions and assumptions clearly
Coordinate data requests, ingestion specifications, secure transfer requirements, and validation steps; troubleshoot gaps and inconsistencies with client data owners
Analyze data using statistical software (e.g., Python, R)
Extract and aggregate data from large sets using SQL, Hive, Spark and other tools
Deploy and support predictive modeling packages and monitor and calibrate production models
Solve problems with innovative data science techniques
Collaborate with data science colleagues and other Visa teams to provide insights to clients.
Automate and create repeatable analyses or self-service tools
Ensure timely project delivery to meet business needs
Promote data innovations and analytics education within Visa
Optimize code for critical business processes
Design and develop dashboards using software like Tableau or Power BI
Communicate complex concepts clearly and effectively
Collect and report market information and intelligence (marketing trends and competitive products and pricing).
Requirement :
Degree (Masters or Ph.D. would be an advantage) in Quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Economics, or engineering or equivalent experience
6+ years of professional work experience preferably in banking, payments, fintech, or a related industry.
Hands-on experience with data analytics/programming tools such as Python, R and advanced skills in querying using SQL or other query languages.
Hands-on experience working in Big Data ecosystems such as Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Kafka, GCP, AWS, and Azure. Experience with both on-prem and cloud environments is a plus.
Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
Proficiency in statistical techniques: Neural Networks, Gradient Boosting, Linear & Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Markov Chains, Support Vector Machines, Clustering, Principal Component Analysis, Factor analysis, etc.
Demonstrated experience in planning, organizing, and managing multiple and concurrent analytics projects with diverse cross-functional stakeholders
Strong internal team and external client stakeholder management with a collaborative, diplomatic, and flexible style; able to work effectively in a matrixed organization
Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, including strong oral and written capabilities
Storyboarding and data storytelling including strong Excel and PowerPoint skills

title: JUNIOR NETWORK ENGINEER
short_description: Currently looking new talent with focus and passionate about ICT especially network technology and other infrastructure systems
job_description:
The
Junior Network Engineer
position is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and security of the company's network infrastructure to ensure stable and efficient IT operations.
Responsibilities :
Maintenance & Monitoring.
Perform regular preventive maintenance checks on network device (e.g. routers, switches, firewalls, access points, etc.). Monitor device health, system logs, and performance indicators to detect early signs of issues. Ensure firmware, patches, and configuration updates are properly implemented as instructed.
Troubleshooting & Support
.
Handle and resolve network issue tickets reported by users or systems quickly and accurately. Assist in configuration, testing and verifying network availability, connectivity, and redundancy.
Network Security
. Monitor suspicious network traffic, and assist with firewall configurations. Escalate identified issues or abnormalities to senior engineers for further action.
Documentation.
Maintain accurate inventory records of network equipment and their maintenance schedules. Document preventive maintenance results, including checklists, reports, and recommendations.
Qualifications :
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field with min GPA 3,00
Basic understanding of networking concepts (OSI Layer, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching).
Familiar with common network devices and operating systems.
Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured procedures.
Good communication and documentation skills.
Willingness to learn and develop technical expertise in network engineering.
Willing to travel around Indonesia for some period of time

title: Jr. Quality Engineer
job_description:
Jr. Engineer – QA
Responsibility:
Carry out the product testing according to international standards, customer requirement and WIK internal requirement.
Product Safety release for engineering sample or modification sample before mass production.
Follow up product approvals with outside approval boards, covering electrical safety, EMC and other mandatory restrictions and requirements in the relevant markets.
Prepare Life Cycle Test (LCT) protocol and LCT report, conduct vibration test and drop test.
Arrange external testing and certification as required, manpower for do LCT and handle internal or external audit. Internal calibration and maintain compliance with ISO 9001 requirement and internal training for Approve Test Laboratory (ATL) process.
Coordinate external calibration with vendor & update the report to RQM.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in mechanical and electrical, with minimum 3 years of experience in the same position.
Experiences in ISO 9001, 14001, ATL test, handling supplier, internal, external audit (customer audit, 3rd party audit) & Factory Inspection. Product certification and calibration monitoring.
Fluent in English reading, speaking and written, solid skill for Microsoft excel, good knowledge of office suite.
Good attitude, adaptability to company culture, teamwork spirit and influence skills, problem solving skills, able to handle multi-task and perform well under pressure and seek for continuous improvement, active listening, presentation skill.
